_comment: La bible des personnages : une description visuelle, ecrite UNE fois, que
chaque prompt d'image reprend mot pour mot des que le personnage apparait
dans la page. Sans elle, chaque image inventait sa propre version -- le
Maitre des Loups changeait de tete d'une illustration a l'autre, et le
heros lui-meme n'etait pas le meme d'une scene a la suivante.
`look` est le texte injecte, verbatim. `aliases` sert a reperer le
personnage dans le texte de la page, dans les deux langues.
`source` dit d'ou vient la description : le livre, ou un choix assume.
Ne PAS reformuler un `look` sans regenerer toutes les images concernees :
c'est la constance du texte qui fait la constance de l'image.

characters.look: THE HERO (in every image, always identical): a lean human adventurer in a hooded green cloak over chainmail, a round wooden shield on the left arm, a straight sword, a leather backpack, seen three-quarters from behind so the face stays hidden.
STRATAGUS: tall and skeletally gaunt, wrapped in a black toga embroidered with scarlet motifs that seem to writhe; hollow face, long thin hands.
GAYOLARD, the good wizard: a stooped old man with a long white beard, a plain blue robe, a knotted wooden staff; kindly, unarmed.
POMPATARTE, the merchant: heavy-set and prosperous, orange tunic over a round belly, rings on his fingers, a sly smile.

characters.source: portage, Amulette a Fleur du livre
characters.look: THE GARDEN MASTER: a lean man in long green robes, bare-headed, a flower-shaped amulet on a chain at his neck, earth on his hands.
THE WOLF MASTER: a burly man in grey wolf pelts, iron-grey hair and a short beard, a wolf-shaped amulet at his neck, heavy fists, no sword.
GROGNARD: rough and plain-looking at first glance, a cross embroidered on his tunic, a sword suddenly at his side; taller than he first appeared.
THE WOLVES: lean grey timber wolves, low shoulders, yellow eyes, bared teeth.
THE POOL BEAST: a mass of thick rubbery tentacles bursting from dark water, no visible head, pale suckers.
THE BRIGANDS: ragged men in patched leather, hoods and scarves over the face, short curved blades.
THE SPIDERS: black long-legged spiders the size of dogs, glossy abdomens, clustered eyes.
THE SCORPIONS: violet-black scorpions the size of a man's torso, raised segmented tail, heavy pincers.
